name: TransMilenio
body: Every linked page answers and AI crawlers are welcome. But none of the 20 pages analyzed has a meta description, the start page included, so search engines write the snippet themselves.
lesson: Write a description of about 150 characters for your ten most visited pages, starting with the home page.
summary: www.transmilenio.gov.co scores 72 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 5 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 5 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /login, /herramientas/buscar, /transparencia-y-acceso-a-la-informacion-publica, /transparencia-y-acceso-a-la-informacion-publica/informacion-entidad. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /login, /herramientas/mapa-del-sitio, /comunicaciones/publicaciones/2025/centro-de-emision-radial-de-transmilenio-cer and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without HttpOnly: XSRF-TOKEN. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /login, /herramientas/mapa-del-sitio and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /login, /herramientas/mapa-del-sitio, /comunicaciones/publicaciones/2025/centro-de-emision-radial-de-transmilenio-cer and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on 19 of 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on 19 of 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page sets a mobile viewport
